en.title: Silicon Valley Chinese Team Beats DeepSeek to Build Next-Gen Super-Agent
en.summary: As DeepSeek proposes its new **Super-agent** architecture to solve human attention limits, a Silicon Valley Chinese team called AFK AI has already built and open-sourced **Comma**, a system using a single Router and multiple Workers. This allows users to manage numerous parallel tasks through a single chat window, moving past the constraints of single sessions.
en.long_summary:
The article explores the architectural consensus between DeepSeek and AFK AI regarding the next generation of AI agents. As humans struggle to manage multiple AI sessions simultaneously, both teams converged on a **single Router and multi-Worker** framework. 

AFK AI's open-source product Comma puts this into practice. It allows users to drop multiple distinct tasks into one chat, letting different background workers execute them concurrently without human intervention. Furthermore, the system handles **cross-environment tasks**, connecting smoothly with communication channels and development tools like Linear.

Beyond concurrent execution, Comma tackles long-term memory and continuous learning. By storing states outside the main context and iteratively training smaller models based on human feedback, the system becomes smarter over time, proving that autonomous, **always-online personal agents** are already a reality.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人把下一代Agent Harness造出来了
zh.summary: 针对DeepSeek提出的**超级智能体**理念，硅谷华人团队AFK AI此前已打造并开源了名为Comma的系统。该系统采用主脑加多执行者的架构，让用户通过**单对话窗口**就能同时处理海量任务，提前把科幻电影里的贾维斯带进现实。
zh.long_summary:
文章探讨了DeepSeek与硅谷华人团队AFK AI在下一代AI智能体架构上的不谋而合。面对人类注意力无法跟进多个AI会话的痛点，两家团队都指向了**主脑加多执行者**的底层架构共识。

AFK AI开源的Comma产品将这一构想落地。用户只需在单个对话框中投入多个任务，系统便会派发给不同的后台Worker并行处理，且支持跨软件环境联动，比如与Linear等开发工具无缝对接。

在核心的记忆与成长方面，Comma通过主对话与长期记忆分离、以及利用人类反馈**持续训练小模型**的机制，让AI在日常使用中不断积累经验，真正实现了越用越聪明，标志着永久在线的个人智能体已不再是科幻。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agents
en.summary: GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pulled together **15 design patterns** for building multi-AI agent systems. Instead of relying on a single AI to do everything, these patterns show how multiple AI workers can team up, check each other's work, and **handle complex tasks** reliably. This helps developers build smarter AI systems that make fewer mistakes.
en.long_summary:
As AI agents move beyond simple chat tools into complex workflows, relying on a single model often leads to errors. To solve this, industry giants like GitHub, Google, and Siemens have compiled 15 practical design patterns for multi-agent systems.

## GitHub's Blueprint and MCP
GitHub outlines how to structure agent responsibilities, utilizing structured outputs like JSON and tools like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). By breaking down tasks and introducing review loops, agents can write, check, and fix code with much higher reliability.

## Google and Siemens' Advanced Patterns
Google focuses on robust application workflows, including error-correction feedback loops and smart database querying. Meanwhile, Siemens applies these concepts to industrial engineering, showing how breaking an elephant into slices helps multi-agent systems manage heavy enterprise codebases efficiently.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合总结：多AI协同工作的15个经典设计模式
zh.summary: GitHub、谷歌和西门子联合总结出了构建多AI协同系统的 **15个设计模式**。简单来说，就是不再让一个AI单打独斗，而是让多个AI组团干活、互相监督，从而把 **复杂的任务** 搞定。这能帮开发者打造出更聪明、更不容易出错的AI应用。
zh.long_summary:
随着AI从简单的聊天工具变成复杂的干活能手，只靠一个AI单打独斗很容易出错。为了解决这个问题，GitHub、谷歌和西门子等科技大厂最近把各自的实战经验整理到一起，归纳出了15个多AI协同的设计模式。

## 结构化分工与错误纠正
GitHub的方案强调如何给不同的AI分配明确的角色，比如让一个AI写代码，另一个AI负责检查和修改。通过规范输出格式并引入反复检查的机制，AI犯错的概率大大降低，干起活来更靠谱。

## 工业级的大规模应用
谷歌和西门子则展示了如何在复杂的业务场景中运用这些模式。比如西门子在处理庞大的工业代码库时，通过把大任务拆成小碎块，让多个AI各司其职，从而实现了高效的自动化工程管理。

en.title: Do AI startups still have a chance with Personal Agents?
en.summary: Personal AI gives startups a **new possibility** to build value outside of foundational models. While big tech companies hold advantages in resources and infrastructure, startups can find success by targeting **specific scenarios** and building deep, trusted relationships with users rather than just playing a silicon arms race.
en.long_summary:
## The Shift Beyond Base Models
For a long time, AI products have been trapped inside the 'egg' of foundation models, risking being swallowed whenever models upgrade or change prices. Personal Agents offer a way out by allowing startups to build value based on deep user context, personal data understanding, and long-term trust, rather than just having the biggest model.

## The Heavy Cost and Big Tech's Strategy
Running personal agents comes with massive costs in cloud resources, virtual environments, and token consumption. Tech giants can treat losses as strategic investments to harvest user task trajectories, making the financial model brutal for early-stage startups that lack capital.

## Finding a Niche and Winning Paths
Personal AI is not a winner-takes-all game because human preferences are diverse and users won't hand all data to a single company. Startups can survive by finding a **narrow, high-value vertical切口**—like personal growth or health—moving from a simple tool to a trusted partner.

zh.title: 创业者做 Personal Agent，有没有一线生机？
zh.summary: Personal Agent 让 AI 创业看到了**新可能**，产品的终极价值可以长在大模型之外。虽然巨头占据资源优势，但创业者可以通过切入**具体场景**，摆脱单纯的模型依赖，在长周期的服务中建立信任与护城河。
zh.long_summary:
## 价值长在基模外
过去很多 AI 应用离不开大模型的卵壳，模型一升级产品就容易失效。Personal Agent 提供了一种破壳的可能，它的核心价值不取决于是否拥有最强的通用模型，而是取决于**高密度的个人上下文**以及长周期沉淀下来的信任关系。

## 巨头的局与创业者的账
Punishingly high cloud, token, and environment costs make the financial model tough for startups. Tech giants can swallow these losses as strategic investments to collect human task trajectories, but startups must carefully calculate whether their user service costs can be covered.

## 从工具走向伙伴的切口
个人智能的格局并非赢家通吃，因为人类偏好离散且用户不愿将一切托付给一家公司。创业者可以通过寻找一个垂直、具体的**高价值切口**，把服务做深，从简单的工具软件演进为用户离不开的成长伙伴。

en.title: AI bubble faces reality as Nasdaq suffers historic crash
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session since April 2025, wiping out over **$2.5 trillion** in market value due to growing concerns over the AI speculative bubble. Sparked partly by political shifts and tighter regulation fears, this drop highlights the **fragility of growth** in a sector facing heavy physical and infrastructure constraints.
en.long_summary:
## Market Crash and Political Triggers
On Thursday, November 5, the tech-heavy Nasdaq plunged 5.5%, marking its biggest one-day points loss ever. This historic drop wiped out over $2.5 trillion in market capitalization in just 24 hours. While mid-term election results brought a Democratic victory and fears of **stricter regulation**, local opposition to data centers also played a role as voters pushed back against massive electricity and water consumption.

## The Reality of Infrastructure Constraints
The spectacular enthusiasm for AI had driven company valuations to irrational levels based on bets rather than profit potential. However, mounting obstacles in building essential infrastructure and questioning the **investment profitability** brought Wall Street back to reality. AI can no longer grow independently from physical constraints and citizen consent.

## Economic Ripple Effects
Beyond financial markets, AI has become a primary engine of the US economy, driven by hundreds of billions in data center investments. A lasting loss of confidence could trigger a vicious cycle, turning AI from an economic driver into the American economy's **Achilles' heel**.

zh.title: 纳斯达克遭遇历史性暴跌，AI泡沫开始面对现实
zh.summary: 由于市场对人工智能投机泡沫的担忧加剧，纳斯达克迎来了2025年4月以来最惨的一天，蒸发了超过 **2.5万亿美元** 的市值。这次暴跌部分由政治变动和更严监管的预期触发，狠狠敲响了警钟，暴露出过度依赖烧钱的AI行业其实 **生长十分脆弱**。
zh.long_summary:
## 市场大跌与政治导火索
在11月5日星期四，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数暴跌5.5%，创下2025年4月以来最惨单日表现，24小时内市值蒸发超过2.5万亿美元。中期选举带来的民主党大胜让市场对 **更严厉的监管** 感到担忧，同时多地选民开始抗议数据中心消耗巨大的电力和水资源，这种反对声音成为了市场回调的催化剂。

## 基础设施的现实约束
此前对AI的热情把公司估值推到了不理性的高度，完全建立在对未来的盲目押注上。随着建设必备基础设施的难度不断增加，投资者开始质疑 **投资回报率**。华尔街终于意识到，这场技术革命无法脱离现实的物理限制和普通老百姓的认可而野蛮生长。

## 经济上的连锁反应
除了金融市场，AI已经成了美国经济的核心引擎之一，数千亿美元的数据中心投资支撑着经济活动。如果市场信心持续崩塌，可能会引发恶性循环，让AI从美国经济的顶梁柱变成 **阿喀琉斯之踵**。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU to cut AI inference costs
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA's Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) technology, allowing users to **divide a physical GPU** into smaller, independent partitions. This update solves the long-standing dilemma where smaller AI models wasted computing power by occupying an entire expensive accelerator. Developers can now run **multiple isolated models** on a single GPU, significantly improving hardware utilization, reducing inference costs, and maintaining predictable performance without complex Kubernetes setups.
en.long_summary:
## Background and Limitations
Previously, deploying an AI model to a GPU endpoint meant requesting at least one whole accelerator. For smaller or medium-sized models, this approach often led to severe under-utilization. Users either had to waste money on unneeded computing power or struggle with complex, self-managed Kubernetes setups to achieve hardware partitioning.

## How It Works
Amazon SageMaker AI now integrates NVIDIA's Multi-Instance GPU capability directly into managed endpoints. By adding simple configuration parameters to existing API calls, users can carve a single GPU into up to seven independent partitions. Each partition features dedicated compute units, memory, and hardware-level isolation, preventing one model's traffic spike from impacting others while eliminating cold starts.

## Performance and Value
Benchmarks comparing an H100 GPU partition against an older whole A100 GPU revealed significant gains. The newer GPU slice delivered **higher output tokens per second** while cutting costs by up to 34 percent per million output tokens on long-context tasks. This gives enterprises a flexible way to right-size their deployments without paying for whole accelerators they do not fully need.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 正式支持 GPU 切片技术，帮企业省钱提效
zh.summary: 亚马逊云科技的 SageMaker 推理服务现在支持英伟达的 GPU 切片技术（MIG），允许用户把一块完整的物理显卡**拆分成多个独立小区块**。这个更新解决了过去小模型白白浪费整张显卡算力的痛点。现在，开发者可以在**单张显卡上运行多个模型**，不仅大大提高了硬件利用率和性价比，还能在没有复杂技术门槛的情况下保持稳定的性能。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与痛点
过去在云端部署 AI 模型时，每次至少得租用一整张显卡。这导致很多体量较小的模型只能白白浪费大部分算力。如果想把大显卡拆开利用，用户就只能自己去折腾复杂的 Kubernetes 集群，维护成本非常高。

## 功能亮点
亚马逊 SageMaker 现在直接把英伟达的 GPU 硬件切片技术做成了托管功能。开发者只需要在现有的 API 里简单加几个参数，就能把一张显卡**拆成最多七个独立小区块**。每个区块都有专属的算力和显存，彼此互不干扰，既安全又能防止互相拖慢速度。

## 实际效果
实测表明，用更新、更强显卡的一个切片去跑模型，不仅**性能明显超越**老旧的整张显卡，还能在大长文任务中降低高达百分之三十四的成本。这让企业在部署不同大小的 AI 模型时有了更划算、更灵活的选择。

en.title: Commercial fridges hacked across Europe as experts warn of a new wave of cyber attacks
en.summary: Recent cyber attacks hit commercial refrigerators across multiple European countries, causing temperatures to soar and sparking fears of a **new hacking wave**. While these attacks exploited existing system flaws rather than relying on advanced artificial intelligence, experts warn that **growing vulnerabilities** and geopolitical tensions mean we should expect more disruptions ahead.
en.long_summary:
## The Fridge Hacks
Retailers in several European countries recently found their commercial refrigeration units heating up dangerously due to a coordinated cyber attack. Investigators traced the issue to vulnerable operating systems and old equipment that no longer received security updates. This incident coincided with other major cyber events, including a massive cryptocurrency theft and a fake nuclear alert in Ukraine, highlighting a general surge in digital disruptions.

## The Role of AI and Geopolitics
Security officials and experts point out two main drivers behind the escalating threat landscape: geopolitics and artificial intelligence. While some attacks bear the hallmarks of state-backed actors like Russia and North Korea, AI is also helping actors find software flaws at an unprecedented scale. However, cybersecurity professionals note that many recent attacks simply exploited basic, unpatched weaknesses, such as default passwords on internet-connected devices.

## What This Means for the Future
The recent string of attacks serves as a stark reminder that everyday smart objects, from commercial fridges to home appliances, are **increasingly susceptible** to remote tampering. Experts emphasize that manufacturers need to build more secure products, and users must keep their software updated. While these disruptive attacks often aim at psychological impact rather than permanent damage, they signal a fragile digital infrastructure that requires much greater vigilance.

zh.title: 欧洲商用冰箱遭黑客集体远程篡改，专家警告网络攻击浪潮来袭
zh.summary: 最近，欧洲多个国家的商用冰箱遭到黑客攻击，温度飙升，引发了人们对**黑客新浪潮**的担忧。虽然这次攻击利用的是老旧系统的已知漏洞，并非全靠人工智能，但专家警告说，随着**漏洞越来越多**以及地缘政治紧张，未来我们得做好面对更多网络干扰的准备。
zh.long_summary:
## 冰箱遭黑客篡改
最近，欧洲多个国家的零售商发现，他们的商用冰箱因为一场协同的网络攻击而危险升温。调查发现，这些问题源于脆弱的操作系统和不再接收安全更新的**老旧设备**。与此同时，还发生了诸如巨额加密货币失窃和乌克兰虚假核警报等重大网络安全事件，凸显出数字干扰的全面激增。

## 人工智能与地缘政治
安全官员和专家指出，威胁加剧背后的两大主要驱动因素是地缘政治和人工智能。虽然有些攻击带有俄罗斯和朝鲜等国家背景的特征，但人工智能也在帮助不法分子以空前规模寻找软件漏洞。不过，网络安全专家指出，许多近期的攻击其实只是利用了基础且未修补的弱点，比如联网设备上的默认密码。

## 对未来的影响
这一系列攻击给人们敲响了警钟，日常智能设备（从商用冰箱到家用电器）正**越来越容易**遭到远程篡改。专家强调，制造商需要生产更安全的设备，用户也必须及时更新软件。虽然这些破坏性攻击往往旨在造成心理冲击而非永久破坏，但它们暴露出脆弱的数字基础设施，需要我们保持更高的警惕。

en.title: NVIDIA Open Source Tools Drive 6G Research
en.summary: NVIDIA's open-source 5G and 6G tools, including Aerial and Sionna, have seen a **10x growth** in global adoption over the past year, with downloads surpassing **1 million**. Researchers worldwide are leveraging these platforms to build smarter, AI-driven wireless networks that enhance robot reaction times, improve signal reception, and save energy.
en.long_summary:
## Background
NVIDIA open-sourced its Aerial wireless software a year ago, combining it with Sionna and other tools to create a foundation for next-generation 6G research. These platforms connect AI training and simulations with real-world wireless experiments.

## Key Applications
Researchers are applying these tools to various challenges. At King’s College London, a robot arm integrated with NVIDIA Sionna reduced task completion time by up to **52.6%** through goal-oriented semantic communications. SoftBank and ETH Zurich demonstrated that AI receivers can significantly improve signal recovery under interference. Meanwhile, the University of Leeds used a portable 5G setup powered by NVIDIA to cut base station power consumption by **45.6%**.

## Industry Impact
Tools like CTTC's GPU-accelerated network simulator have reduced simulation times from hours to just **10-20 minutes**. This massive speedup allows researchers to test and refine innovative network designs much faster before actual deployment.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具助力全球科研人员加速6G网络研发
zh.summary: 过去一年里，英伟达的5G和6G开源工具全球下载量突破**100万次**，开发者采用率暴增**10倍**。来自全球各地的研究人员正利用这些平台开发更聪明的AI原生无线网络，不仅能让机器人反应更快、信号接收更好，还能实现智能省电。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景介绍
一年前，英伟达开源了其Aerial无线软件，并与Sionna及其他工具组合，为下一代6G网络研发奠定了基础。这些工具将人工智能训练、仿真模拟与现实世界的无线实验紧密连接起来，为全球研究人员提供了一个测试想法和共享成果的共同平台。

## 核心应用与突破
全球研究人员正利用这些工具攻克各种无线网络难题。在英国国王学院，研究人员将机器人手臂与英伟达Sionna结合，使机器人任务完成时间缩短了最高**52.6%**。软银集团和苏黎世联邦理工学院通过AI接收机显著提升了复杂干扰环境下的信号恢复能力。此外，利兹大学利用英伟达技术实现了基站能耗降低**45.6%**。

## 行业影响与仿真提速
加泰罗尼亚电信技术中心利用GPU加速的无线电信道模型，将原本需要数小时的网络仿真时间缩短至**10到20分钟**。这种效率的大幅提升，能够帮助行业在实际部署之前更快地测试和评估各种创新的网络设计方案。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, a controlled simulation framework designed to help robots learn complex physical tasks like sorting and stacking blocks. By creating a standardized environment with realistic physics, the system automatically generates training data and tests how well robot models handle spatial reasoning and generalization.
en.long_summary:
## Background and Motivation
Robot learning often suffers from narrow demonstrations that fail to explain why a robot succeeds or struggles. Inspired by controlled environments in science like petri dishes, the creators built FoundationWorlds, starting with **ToyBlocks**, to let researchers systematically study robotics questions by altering training data and model designs in a constrained setting.

## Core Mechanics and Features
ToyBlocks centers on a robot arm and blocks on a tabletop, utilizing realistic physics and automatic demonstration generation. By combining reinforcement learning, motion planning, and vision language models like Molmo 2, the framework can automatically produce thousands of skill demonstrations without tedious manual teleoperation. It allows researchers to evaluate spatial generalization, long-horizon planning, and agentic tool use using models like Claude.

## Real-World Transfer and Impact
Experiments showed that policies trained entirely in the ToyBlocks simulation could be deployed zero-shot onto a physical Franka robot arm with comparable success rates. By open-sourcing code, data, and models, the project aims to help the research community advance robot learning toward more reliable and generalizable real-world applications.

zh.title: ToyBlocks：一个专为机器人学习和评估打造的虚拟实验小世界
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了名为 **ToyBlocks** 的受控仿真框架，旨在帮机器人更好地学习积木堆叠和分类等复杂物理任务。通过建立一个具有真实物理效果的标准虚拟环境，该系统能够自动生成训练数据，并测试机器人模型在空间推理和泛化能力上的表现。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与动机
机器人的学习往往受限于狭隘的演示数据，很难解释它们为什么成功或失败。受科学实验中培养皿等受控环境的启发，开发团队打造了 FoundationWorlds，并推出了首个世界模型 **ToyBlocks**，让研究人员能够通过在受限环境中改变训练数据和模型设计，系统地研究机器人技术问题。

## 核心机制与功能
ToyBlocks 围绕桌面上的机械臂和积木展开，具备逼真的物理效果和自动生成演示的能力。通过结合强化学习、运动规划以及像 Molmo 2 这样的视觉语言模型，该框架无需繁琐的手动远程遥控，就能自动生成数千个技能演示。它允许研究人员评估空间推理、长周期规划以及智能体工具调用的能力。
## 现实迁移与影响
实验表明，完全在 ToyBlocks 仿真中训练的策略可以零样本部署到真实的机械臂上，并取得相当的成功率。通过开源代码、数据和模型，该项目旨在帮助研究界推动机器人学习朝着更可靠、更具泛化能力的现实应用发展。

en.title: Why Chinese Baijiu is Booming in South Korea Through Highballs
en.summary: While China's overall liquor exports are dipping, exports to **South Korea** have surged by 85%. Instead of traditional neat shots at formal banquets, young South Koreans are mixing cheap **sorghum liquor** with tonic water, ice, and even canned fruit flavors. This localized twist turns fiery Chinese spirits into low-alcohol, trendy drinks sold conveniently in local stores.
en.long_summary:
## Historical Roots
Chinese liquor's popularity in South Korea dates back over a century. In the late 19th century, merchants and laborers from China's Shandong province moved to the Korean peninsula, bringing their native **clear sorghum liquor** and traditional cuisine. Although the ethnic Chinese population later dwindled due to local laws, the neighborhood Chinese restaurants and the habit of pairing food with sorghum liquor stayed firmly rooted among local consumers.

## The Mixology Revolution
South Koreans have completely reinvented how they drink baijiu by borrowing a page from whiskey's playbook. Driven by the massive popularity of **Highballs**—mixing spirits with soda and ice—young consumers now combine affordable sorghum liquor with tonic water or beer. Local convenience stores and celebrity chefs quickly capitalized on this trend, launching ready-to-drink canned sorghum highballs that became immediate bestsellers.

## Market Impact
While budget-friendly sorghum brands dominate the convenience store shelves through creative mixing, high-end Chinese luxury baijiu is simultaneously making inroads into upscale supermarkets and fine-dining restaurants via local distribution giants. However, this localization means that South Korean convenience stores and importers are largely driving product innovation and capturing the branding benefits, leaving Chinese wine makers to figure out how to reclaim the profits and discourse in overseas markets.

zh.title: 中国白酒在韩国意外大火，年轻人为什么开始抢着喝？
zh.summary: 今年中国白酒出口整体在下滑，但对韩国的出口额却逆势暴涨了85%。在中国，白酒通常是长辈在酒桌上端着小杯子一口闷的烈酒；但在韩国，当地年轻人把它放进便利店，加上冰块、汤力水甚至做成罐装汽水来喝。这种**混饮新吃法**完美避开了白酒香气太冲的毛病，让中国白酒摇身一变成了便利店里的时尚潮饮。
zh.long_summary:
## 百年移民史留下的味觉习惯
中国白酒在韩国的流行其实有一百多年的历史。早在19世纪末，大量来自山东的商人和劳工来到朝鲜半岛，在当地开起了中餐馆，也将胶东一带的清香型高粱酒带到了韩国。后来华侨虽然陆续离开，但中餐馆和高粱酒留了下来，让韩国成了少有的、白酒消费者以当地人为主的海外市场。

## 年轻人把白酒当成鸡尾酒喝
随着威士忌调饮文化在韩国年轻人中爆火，韩国人直接把这套方法套在了中国高粱酒上。他们不再习惯纯饮高度烈酒，而是把高粱酒兑上汤力水、苏打水或者啤酒，甚至有便利店直接联手名厨推出了罐装的高粱气泡酒。这种低度、清爽的**混饮方式**，彻底打破了白酒在海外喝法单一的僵局。

## 谁在赚走品牌溢价
韩国的白酒市场目前分成了两层：一层是靠年轻人兑着喝的平价大众高粱酒，在便利店里卖得火热；另一层则是靠当地大牌代理铺进高端超市的名酒。虽然韩国市场整体规模还不大，但它提供了一个生动的出海样本。不过这也带来了一个新课题：当韩国人自己把白酒改造成当地口味时，大部分的渠道利润和品牌红利，也顺理成章地落入了**韩国商家**的口袋里。

en.title: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
en.summary: I tested **NYT Cooking's** new AI assistant for ingredient swaps and recipe scaling. It smartly suggests alternatives and saves you from digging through hundreds of user comments, though you still need to **double-check** its measurements to avoid kitchen disasters.
en.long_summary:
## How it works
The AI assistant appears on recipe pages in a small text box where you can type requests like ingredient substitutions or scaling. It was trained on user comments and successfully helped modify a chicken and rice recipe based on available fridge items, while sensibly rejecting bizarre requests like putting beef in a dessert.

## The good and the bad
While it makes cooking on the fly much easier by creating a separate customized version of the recipe, it is not flawless. During baking tests, it nearly caused a dry cake by confusing the butter measurements between the original and modified recipes when asked via voice typing.

## The verdict
Acting as a helpful sous chef rather than the head chef, the tool streamlines everyday cooking dilemmas and saves trips to the grocery store, though recipe purists can easily scroll past it.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪AI助手帮我搞定了鸡肉，却差点毁了我的蛋糕
zh.summary: 我测试了《纽约时报》烹饪频道的全新 **AI助手**，用来替换食材和调整分量。它能聪明地给出替代方案，省去了翻看数百条用户评论的麻烦，不过你还是得 **仔细核对** 它的用量，以免发生厨房翻车事故。
zh.long_summary:
## 功能与体验
这个AI助手直接嵌入在菜谱页面的文本框里，你可以输入替换食材或调整分量等要求。它基于用户评论进行了训练，能根据你冰箱里现有的食材巧妙修改菜谱，同时它也很有分寸，会拒绝像在甜点里加牛肉这种离谱的要求。

## 优点与小插曲
虽然它能为用户生成一个单独的定制版菜谱，让临时下厨变得轻松得多，但它并非十全十美。在烘焙测试中，当通过语音询问黄油用量时，它差点把原版和修改版的黄油分量搞混，如果照做可能会烤出一个干巴巴的蛋糕。

## 总结评价
作为厨房里的帮厨而非主厨，这个工具大大简化了日常做饭的麻烦，省去了临时跑超市的工夫，而对于喜欢原汁原味的传统做饭党来说，直接划过去无视它也很方便。

en.title: US midterms deliver a blow to Elon Musk and data center expansion
en.summary: The recent **midterm elections** dealt a blow to tech giants, as voters overwhelmingly rejected new data centers and elected politicians promising strict regulations. Meanwhile, **Elon Musk** saw little return from his massive political donations, and companies like **OpenAI** are scrambling to change their secretive policies to appease the public.
en.long_summary:
## The Election Fallout
Democrats' success in the midterm elections is reshaping the political landscape for the tech industry. Voters across the country rejected ballot measures that would have fast-tracked data centers, while electing politicians like Texas' new governor-elect Gina Hinojosa who campaigned on restricting these massive facilities. Notably, Elon Musk received virtually no political return after donating half a billion dollars to Republicans, leaving his companies based in a state that has shifted heavily toward Democrats.

## Grassroots Backlash
Tech experts point out that the anti-data center sentiment is a powerful grassroots movement rather than just a partisan issue. Communities are furious over the secretive approval processes, non-disclosure agreements with local officials, and the massive water and power consumption of these facilities in environmentally sensitive areas. 

## Corporate Shifts
In response to mounting public pressure and regulatory threats, tech companies are beginning to pivot. OpenAI recently released a new policy blueprint promising to drop non-disclosure agreements and operate with more transparency, even attempting to rebrand traditional 'data centers' as 'compute campuses.' However, combined with Wall Street's growing skepticism over massive AI spending, the future of data center expansion faces mounting financial and regulatory hurdles.

zh.title: 美国中期选举失利，埃隆·马斯克和数据中心扩张遇到大麻烦
zh.summary: 美国最新**中期选举**对科技巨头泼了冷水，选民们纷纷投票反对修建新的数据中心，并选出了承诺严格监管的政治人物。与此同时，**埃隆·马斯克**的巨额政治捐款打了水漂，而像**OpenAI**这样的公司也坐不住了，正忙着改变以往遮遮掩掩的政策来平息民愤。
zh.long_summary:
## 选举带来的政治冲击
民主党在中期选举中的大获全胜，正在彻底改变科技行业的政治环境。全美各地的选民不仅投票否决了旨在加速数据中心建设的提案，还选出了像得克萨斯州新当选州长吉娜·希诺霍萨这样承诺限制数据中心的政客。值得注意的是，埃隆·马斯克向共和党捐赠了巨资，却几乎没有捞到任何政治好处，如今他的公司总部反而落在一个政治倾向大幅倒向民主党的州里。

## 基层民众的强烈反对
科技观察人士指出，反对数据中心的情绪已经演变成一场强大的基层运动，而不仅仅是党派之争。由于科技公司在项目审批时往往采取暗箱操作、迫使地方官员签署保密协议，且这些设施在水资源紧缺的地区疯狂消耗水和电，引发了当地社区的强烈不满。

## 科技巨头的应对转变
面对日益高涨的公众怒火和监管压力，科技公司开始做出妥协。OpenAI最近发布了一份新政策蓝图，承诺放弃保密协议、提高透明度，甚至试图把传统的“数据中心”改名为听起来更温和的“计算园区”。然而，再加上华尔街对巨额AI投资越来越谨慎，未来数据中心的扩张之路将面临更多金钱和政策上的双重阻碍。

en.title: Claude-Mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,590 | Your coding agent forgets everything between sessions, forcing you to repeat instructions. **Claude-Mem** runs a background observer to capture your agent's work, compress it with AI, and automatically **inject relevant context** into future sessions. It supports Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and many other popular agents.
en.long_summary:
## How It Works
Claude-Mem works seamlessly by placing hooks into your AI coding tool. When your agent reads, edits, or runs code, a local background worker **captures the activity**. A secondary observer agent then turns this raw activity into concise observations and summaries, storing them in a local SQLite database.

## Smart Context Injection
When you start a new session, your agent **gets a compact index** of past observations instead of starting from zero. It only pulls in heavy details when specifically needed, saving precious tokens and keeping context relevant without manual intervention.

## Installation & Supported Tools
Getting started is as simple as running a single command. You can install it via **interactive terminal commands** using `npx claude-mem install` or via plugin marketplaces. It supports a wide range of developers' favorite tools including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and OpenClaw.

## Team & Privacy Features
Your memory stays secure locally in your machine (`~/.claude-mem`), and anything wrapped in private tags is completely ignored. For teams, optional features like **TeamBrain** let you share insights and work lists securely with your colleagues.

zh.title: Claude-Mem：为每个AI编程助手实现跨会话的持久化记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,590 | 你的AI编程助手在每次重新对话时都会失忆，让你不得不重复喂提示词。**Claude-Mem** 在后台默默记录助手的工作，用 AI 压缩提炼，并在下次对话时**自动注入关键记忆**。它完美支持 Claude Code、Cursor、OpenCode 等众多主流 AI 工具。
zh.long_summary:
## 工作原理
Claude-Mem 通过在你的 AI 编程工具中嵌入钩子（Hooks）来无缝工作。当你的 AI 助手阅读、编辑或运行代码时，本地的后台服务会**捕获这些活动**。接着，一个观察员 AI 会将这些活动提炼为简短的观察记录和摘要，并安全存储在本地数据库中。

## 智能上下文注入
当你开启新对话时，助手不再从零开始，而是会获得一个**精简的记忆索引**。它只有在真正需要时才会去调取详细内容，从而在节省大量 Token 的同时，保持对话上下文的连贯性。

## 安装与支持工具
安装过程非常简单，只需在终端运行一条命令即可。你可以通过 `npx claude-mem install` 快速完成配置，或者直接通过插件市场安装。它支持包括 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw 在内的多种主流 AI 助手。

## 团队协作与隐私保护
你的记忆默认安全地保存在本地电脑中（`~/.claude-mem`），任何被私密标签包裹的内容都会被严格过滤。对于团队用户，它还提供了 **TeamBrain** 等可选功能，让团队成员能够安全地共享项目发现与工作进展。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git worktree manager built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.summary: ⭐ 11,981 | Worktrunk is a CLI tool designed to make **Git worktrees as easy as branches**. It solves the problem of clunky native worktree commands, allowing developers to smoothly run **multiple AI agents in parallel** without stepping on each other's toes.
en.long_summary:
## Context and Purpose

As AI agents like Claude Code become capable of handling longer, unsupervised tasks, developers often want to run **5-10+ agents in parallel**. Git's native worktree feature provides each agent with its own working directory, but the default user experience is clunky and requires typing branch names multiple times. Worktrunk addresses this by making worktrees as easy as branches.

## Core Commands and Features

Worktrunk simplifies your workflow with intuitive core commands like **`wt switch`** for creating and switching worktrees, and `wt list` for viewing status. It also includes advanced features such as workflow automation hooks, LLM-generated commit messages, and a **shared build cache** that lets multiple worktrees share dependencies without rebuilding or copying them.

## Installation and Getting Started

Worktrunk can be easily installed via Homebrew, Cargo, or other package managers. Once installed, commands like **`wt switch --create`** instantly create a new branch and worktree, letting you jump straight into development or launch parallel AI agents with custom setup hooks.

zh.title: Worktrunk：专为并行 AI 代理工作流打造的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,981 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，旨在让 **Git 工作树像分支一样简单易用**。它解决了原生工作树命令繁琐的痛点，让开发者能够顺畅地**同时运行多个 AI 代理**而不会互相冲突。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与目标

随着像 Claude Code 这样的 AI 代理能够处理更长的、无人看管的任务，开发者经常需要**同时运行 5 到 10 个以上的代理**。Git 原生的工作树功能为每个代理提供了独立的目录，但默认的体验非常笨拙，需要重复输入分支名称。Worktrunk 的诞生就是为了**让工作树像分支一样简单**。

## 核心命令与功能

Worktrunk 通过直观的核心命令简化了你的工作流，例如用于创建和切换工作树的 **`wt switch`**，以及用于查看状态的 `wt list`。它还包含高级功能，例如工作流自动化钩子、LLM 生成的提交信息，以及**共享构建缓存**，让多个工作树无需重新构建或复制即可共享依赖项。

## 安装与快速上手

Worktrunk 可以通过 Homebrew、Cargo 或其他包管理器轻松安装。安装完成后，诸如 **`wt switch --create`** 的命令可以瞬间创建一个新分支和工作树，让你直接投入开发，或者配合自定义的设置钩子启动并行 AI 代理。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Environments
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **Harness-S**, a new training method to make AI agents more capable and reliable. Instead of looking for one single perfect execution environment, it creates a pool of specialized helper environments. When the main environment fails, these helper environments step in to **rescue the task**, and their success is eventually taught back to the core AI model so it performs better on its own.
en.long_summary:
## Background
Training AI agents to handle complex tasks like coding or database operations often relies on an execution environment, but a single environment design inevitably fails on certain edge cases. Tweaking the environment usually fixes some errors while silently breaking others.

## Method
Instead of searching for a universally superior environment, Harness-S develops specialized sibling environments along distinct repair directions. It uses an **adaptive router** powered by LLMs to select the best helper environments only when all initial attempts in the base environment fail. The successful execution paths are then used to train the core AI policy.

## Impact
Tests across benchmarks like AppWorld and SWE-Gym show that models trained with Harness-S **significantly outperform** standard training methods, proving that experience from auxiliary environments can successfully transfer into the core AI model.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用“兄弟环境”帮AI智能体变得更聪明
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名叫 **Harness-S** 的新型训练方法，专门用来让AI智能体变得更聪明、更靠谱。它不再费劲寻找单一完美的运行环境，而是建立了一个专属的“帮手环境池”。当主力环境把任务搞砸时，这些帮手环境就会出面 **收拾残局**，并把成功的经验重新教给AI模型，让它回到最初的环境也能独自干得更好。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景
训练AI智能体去处理写代码或查数据库这种复杂任务时，通常需要一个运行环境。但单一的环境设计总会在某些特殊情况下翻车，修好一个漏洞往往又会悄悄引发另一个问题。

## 方法
Harness-S没有去寻找那个虚无缥缈的完美环境，而是沿着不同的修复方向开发了一批专门的兄弟环境。它利用一个 **智能路由器**，只有当基础环境的所有尝试都失败时，才会请出这些帮手环境来救场。随后，这些成功救场的经验会被拿来喂给AI模型，提升其综合能力。

## 影响
在多个权威测试集上的实验表明，使用Harness-S训练出来的AI模型能够 **大幅超越** 传统训练方式，这证明了让AI在各种辅助环境中学习的策略，确实能真正转化为模型自身的硬实力。
